build_regex_replacer: build a python module that compiles a regex pattern and returns a callable replacer function for text
create_url_replacer: create a function that returns a callable to replace URLs in text with a custom string
create_hashtag_replacer: create a function that returns a callable to replace ASCII hashtags in text with a custom string
create_non_printing_char_replacer: create a function that returns a callable to replace non-printable Unicode characters in text
test_remove_url: test the url replacer function by replacing URLs in sample text with underscores or spaces
